acceptance: Reproduce with a Polars run that has --capture-plans and show the paths in the generated .plans.json.
Redact or relativize data paths at capture time (before fingerprinting decisions are made, or document the fingerprint effect), without changing plan structure.
Fix the empty test-type key so Polars keys follow the same shape as other platforms, with a migration note if existing results are affected.
A test asserts no absolute home or output path appears in a Polars plans companion.
context: Found by the site viewer work (benchbox-site PR #124). Privacy-class defect: check published bundles for leaked paths too. Verification rubric: reproduction before; fix; regression test; focused suites; comment-policy and ruff; PR merged with green CI and passing oracle review.
description: The Polars DataFrame plans companion stores plan_data.logical_plan text that includes absolute local Parquet paths (for example /Users/<name>/...). Any published Polars .plans.json would expose a contributor's directory layout and username; the site only reads the file and cannot fix it. The same companion keys entries with an empty test type (Q1#0:), unlike the DuckDB and SQLite keys, so key shape differs by platform.
